arguments.sql:
WITH appearances AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.round, p.driver_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.constructor_id) AS constructor_count, MIN(p.constructor_id) AS constructor_id
    FROM main.races AS r
    JOIN main.results AS p ON p.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, r.round, p.driver_id
),
season_appearances AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, MIN(round) AS first_appearance, MAX(round) AS last_appearance, COUNT(*) AS appearance_count
    FROM appearances
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
misses AS (
    SELECT a.year, a.driver_id, MIN(r.round) AS first_missed, MAX(r.round) AS last_missed, COUNT(*) AS missed_count
    FROM season_appearances AS a
    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.year = a.year AND r.round BETWEEN a.first_appearance AND a.last_appearance
    LEFT JOIN appearances AS p ON p.year = a.year AND p.round = r.round AND p.driver_id = a.driver_id
    WHERE p.driver_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY a.year, a.driver_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) < 3
),
season_sizes AS (
    SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM main.races GROUP BY year
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS eligible_breaks,
    SUM(m.last_missed - m.first_missed + 1 > m.missed_count) AS noncontiguous_breaks,
    SUM(b.constructor_count > 1 OR a.constructor_count > 1) AS ambiguous_constructors,
    SUM(s.race_count - p.appearance_count < 3) AS fewer_than_3_with_edges,
    SUM(s.race_count - p.appearance_count = m.missed_count) AS no_edge_absences,
    AVG(m.first_missed) AS avg_first_round,
    AVG(m.last_missed) AS avg_last_round,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT year) FROM main.races AS r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main.results AS p WHERE p.race_id = r.race_id)) AS years_with_resultless_races
FROM misses AS m
JOIN appearances AS b ON b.year = m.year AND b.driver_id = m.driver_id AND b.round = m.first_missed - 1
JOIN appearances AS a ON a.year = m.year AND a.driver_id = m.driver_id AND a.round = m.last_missed + 1
JOIN season_appearances AS p ON p.year = m.year AND p.driver_id = m.driver_id
JOIN season_sizes AS s ON s.year = m.year
WHERE b.constructor_id <> a.constructor_id
LIMIT 1

WITH appearances AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.round, p.driver_id, MIN(p.constructor_id) AS low_constructor, MAX(p.constructor_id) AS high_constructor
    FROM main.races AS r
    JOIN main.results AS p ON p.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, r.round, p.driver_id
),
driver_years AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT year, driver_id FROM appearances
),
misses AS (
    SELECT d.year, d.driver_id, MIN(r.round) AS first_missed, MAX(r.round) AS last_missed, COUNT(*) AS miss_count
    FROM driver_years AS d
    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.year = d.year
    LEFT JOIN appearances AS a ON a.year = d.year AND a.driver_id = d.driver_id AND a.round = r.round
    WHERE a.driver_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY d.year, d.driver_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) < 3
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS bounded_driver_years,
    SUM(b.low_constructor <> b.high_constructor OR a.low_constructor <> a.high_constructor) AS multiple_constructors_at_bounds,
    SUM(b.low_constructor <> a.low_constructor) AS switches,
    SUM(b.low_constructor <> a.low_constructor AND m.last_missed - m.first_missed + 1 > m.miss_count) AS switches_with_separate_absences,
    SUM(m.year = 2024 AND b.low_constructor <> a.low_constructor) AS switches_in_2024,
    AVG(CASE WHEN b.low_constructor <> a.low_constructor THEN m.first_missed END) AS avg_first_round,
    AVG(CASE WHEN b.low_constructor <> a.low_constructor THEN m.last_missed END) AS avg_last_round
FROM misses AS m
JOIN appearances AS b ON b.year = m.year AND b.driver_id = m.driver_id AND b.round = m.first_missed - 1
JOIN appearances AS a ON a.year = m.year AND a.driver_id = m.driver_id AND a.round = m.last_missed + 1
LIMIT 1

arguments.sql:
WITH appearances AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.round, p.driver_id, p.constructor_id
    FROM main.races AS r
    JOIN main.results AS p ON p.race_id = r.race_id
),
driver_years AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT year, driver_id
    FROM appearances
),
missed_races AS (
    SELECT
        d.year,
        d.driver_id,
        MIN(r.round) AS first_missed_round,
        MAX(r.round) AS last_missed_round
    FROM driver_years AS d
    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.year = d.year
    LEFT JOIN appearances AS a
        ON a.year = d.year
        AND a.driver_id = d.driver_id
        AND a.round = r.round
    WHERE a.driver_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY d.year, d.driver_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) < 3
)
SELECT
    AVG(m.first_missed_round) AS avg_first_round,
    AVG(m.last_missed_round) AS avg_last_round
FROM missed_races AS m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM appearances AS before_miss
    JOIN appearances AS after_miss
        ON after_miss.year = before_miss.year
        AND after_miss.driver_id = before_miss.driver_id
        AND after_miss.round = m.last_missed_round + 1
        AND after_miss.constructor_id <> before_miss.constructor_id
    WHERE before_miss.year = m.year
      AND before_miss.driver_id = m.driver_id
      AND before_miss.round = m.first_missed_round - 1
)
LIMIT 1
